observations: Photo 0 shows a white and silver freestanding gas cooker with an oven below and four control knobs on the front panel.
The oven door has a glass window with a visible reflection and a white handle.
Photo 1 shows a top-down view of the cooktop with four burners and a metal grate over a perforated surface.
The cooktop appears clean but has some minor discoloration or residue on the grate and around the burners.
No brand or model is visible on the front or top of the unit in either photo.
The seller claims it is a 4-burner gas cooker with oven, which matches the visual evidence.
The seller claims all four burners light properly with strong blue flame — this cannot be verified from still photos.

claims.claim: Clean, fairly used 4-burner gas cooker with oven.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a 4-burner gas cooker with an oven. The unit appears clean with minor signs of use.

claims.claim: All four burners light properly with strong blue flame.
claims.evidence: No video or photo shows the burners lit. Functionality cannot be confirmed from still images.

risks.risk: Burners may not light or may have weak/uneven flame.
risks.proof: A video clip showing all four burners lit with strong blue flame.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with reduced functionality

risks.risk: Oven may not heat properly or may have internal damage.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the oven interior and a test of heating (e.g., light inside or temperature probe).
A video showing the unit connected to gas with no visible leaks (e.g., soapy water test).

proof_requests: Video showing all four burners lit with strong blue flame.
Photo or video of the oven interior and a test of heating.
Video of the unit connected to gas with a soapy water test for leaks.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a 4-burner gas cooker with oven, but critical claims about functionality (burners lighting, oven working) and safety (gas leaks) cannot be verified from the photos alone. These risks affect pricing and must be proven before a price can be assigned.
